description: Check spend against one or more budgets you pass in (daily, weekly = rolling last 7 days, monthly = calendar month), optionally for one project or a set of providers. For each budget: spent, remaining, percent used with a status, and a progress bar; weekly and monthly also project to the end of the period at the average daily rate so far. Use it for a scoped budget question ("is project X on track this month?"); for a whole-account red/yellow/green status with hours left at the current hourly burn, use tokmeter_budget_alert. Nothing is stored: budgets live only in the call.
name: tokmeter_budget
